protocol_name: Prognostic Validation of Frozen Baseline EEG Temporal Scores for DoC Recovery
core_research_question: Does the frozen baseline EEG temporal score S(x) contain incremental prognostic information regarding long-term functional recovery, beyond baseline clinical diagnosis and CRS-R score?

inclusion: Adult patients with diagnosed prolonged disorder of consciousness (MCS or VS/UWS) at baseline
Resting-state multichannel EEG recording of minimum 120 seconds duration with retention >= 50%
Documented post-baseline functional outcome on standard scale (e.g., GOS at 6 months) with verified 1-to-1 patient identity linkage
exclusion: Absence of verified subject-level linkage between raw EEG recording and longitudinal outcome label
Identity mapping ambiguity caused by duplicate demographic or CRS-R collisions without independent cross-referencing

figshare_ling2024.unfavorable_condition: GOS < 4 (Severe Disability, Persistent Vegetative State, or Death)
figshare_ling2024.pre_specified_split: 17 favorable vs 33 unfavorable as reported in CNS Neurosci Ther 2024;30:e14421

wielek_2018.endpoint_name: Longitudinal Clinical Recovery vs Non-Recovery / Death
wielek_2018.target_interval_months: Variable (1 to 150 months; right-censored time-to-event analysis)
wielek_2018.favorable_condition: Documented emergence or recovery of functional consciousness (eMCS, SD)
wielek_2018.missing_handling: Excluded from binary analysis; censored at last follow-up for survival models

pre_specified_statistical_analysis.hypothesis_1_nonparametric: Mann-Whitney U test comparing S(x) between favorable and unfavorable recovery groups
pre_specified_statistical_analysis.hypothesis_2_effect_size: Odds Ratio (OR) per 1-SD increase in S(x) via Logistic Regression (or Firth penalized LR for small samples)
pre_specified_statistical_analysis.hypothesis_3_incremental_value: Multivariable logistic regression S(x) + CRS-R vs CRS-R alone evaluated via Likelihood Ratio Test (Delta chi^2, p-value)
pre_specified_statistical_analysis.hypothesis_4_fixed_decision: Sensitivity, Specificity, Positive Predictive Value (PPV), Negative Predictive Value (NPV) at fixed threshold S > 0.0451 without ROC post-hoc tuning
